## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

**1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?**
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 8/11 sectors positive. Confirmations: broad sector positivity (Healthcare, Technology, Financials positive) and mixed internals — strong 1W tech pops but many are RECOVERY patterns, signaling conflicted leadership.

**2. Which sectors are leading?**
Healthcare lead: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND. Technology strength in 1W movers but mixed longer-term: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; Financials showing breadth: MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth snapshot: Healthcare 14/17 positive, Technology 16/24 positive, Financials 13/20 positive.

**3. Which sectors are lagging?**
Utilities weak: VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND. Energy soft: XOM (1W: -0.33% | 1M: -8.34%) BELOW TREND, CVX (1W: -1.76% | 1M: -9.78%) BELOW TREND. Real Estate mixed/weak: DLR (1W: -9.95% | 1M: -6.84%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth snapshot: Utilities 3/10 positive, Energy 4/10 positive, Real Estate 4/10 positive.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

**4. Top Performing Stocks?**
Top 5: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, ADBE (1W: +13.60% | 1M: -16.17%) RECOVERY, APD (1W: +12.94% | 1M: +13.19%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Narrow (4/5 Technology) — caution on concentration.

**5. Worst Performing Stocks?**
Bottom 5: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, LRCX (1W: -12.55% | 1M: +5.16%) CORRECTION, NUE (1W: -11.09% | 1M: -14.38%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND, VST (1W: -9.97% | 1M: -4.25%) BELOW TREND. Weakness concentrated in select tech semi and utilities names.

**6. Momentum Stocks?**
Best 1W momentum: PLTR (1W: +20.54% | 1M: -15.03%) RECOVERY, NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY, PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND; watch major divergence between strong 1W tech movers and negative 1M readings as tactical, not structural.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

**7. Technology Outlook?**
Mixed but active: many big names showing short-term bounces into negative 1M prints — AAPL (1W: +12.17% | 1M: -2.08%) RECOVERY, MSFT (1W: +10.67% | 1M: -11.52%) RECOVERY, NVDA (1W: -0.46% | 1M: -12.46%) BELOW TREND. Sector breadth: Technology 16/24 positive; internals show rotation within the sector.

**8. Financials Outlook?**
Constructive and more uniform: V (1W: +9.56% | 1M: +14.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND, JPM (1W: -0.19% | 1M: +11.13%) CORRECTION. Sector breadth: Financials 13/20 positive — supports stability vs tech idiosyncrasies.

**9. Healthcare Outlook?**
Healthy leadership and confirmation: JNJ (1W: +7.42% | 1M: +18.01%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +7.65% | 1M: +14.07%) ABOVE TREND, UNH (1W: +2.37% | 1M: +13.20%) ABOVE TREND. Sector breadth: Healthcare 14/17 positive — defensive but showing genuine upside.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective exposure to Financials and Healthcare given confirmed ABOVE TREND names (MA, V, JNJ, UNH) and the broad 8/11 sector positivity; reduce exposure to the narrow set of tech names that dominate top performance (PLTR, NOW, ADBE) until 1M confirmations arrive. Style: mixed / no clear leadership — monitor narrow tech concentration as a tactical risk.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

**11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: PANW (1W: +18.76% | 1M: +17.12%) ABOVE TREND, MA (1W: +10.32% | 1M: +12.92%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: QCOM (1W: -13.98% | 1M: -26.55%) BELOW TREND, CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND.

**12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?**
BULLISH: Healthcare (Breadth: 14/17 positive) — leadership intact. BEARISH: Utilities (Breadth: 3/10 positive) — idiosyncratic weakness to monitor.

**13. Key Levels & Triggers?**
PANW hold above recent breakout (watch 1W follow-through to confirm ABOVE TREND continuation), AAPL retest support near its 1W pivot (watch for RECOVERY failure), QCOM breakdown below recent 1W lows would reinforce BELOW TREND trend continuation.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

**14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?**
NVS (1W: +3.50% | 1M: +9.00%) ABOVE TREND (+85): EU approval headline aligns with price strength — confirming accumulation. ABT (1W: +3.00% | 1M: +8.00%) ABOVE TREND (+80): DOJ legal clearance is confirmed by upside; monitor follow-through. PM (1W: +2.00% | 1M: +6.00%) ABOVE TREND (+80): FDA nod sentiment aligns with sector resilience.

**15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?**
NOW (1W: +18.77% | 1M: -16.71%) RECOVERY (-75): Very bearish headlines vs strong 1W rally — clear divergence, watch for distribution. CEG (1W: -10.96% | 1M: -12.25%) BELOW TREND (-50): Negative coverage confirms price weakness. EA (1W: -2.50% | 1M: -4.00%) CORRECTION (-60): downgrade headlines align with near-term softness (monitor for further downside).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL, style mixed / no clear leadership. PANW ABOVE TREND, MA ABOVE TREND and JNJ ABOVE TREND are showing relative strength. Key risk: narrow tech leadership and multiple RECOVERY patterns (NOW, ADBE, AAPL, MSFT) create divergence — watch news-driven distribution vs price confirmation.
